source_reference_contract.canonical: An unprefixed source reference names a record in release/source-skill-lineage/source-manifest.json.
source_reference_contract.component: A component:<id> reference names a public component whose source identity must be bound separately from its aggregate or private overlay.
source_reference_contract.observed: An observed:<id> or observed-route:<id> reference is provisional installed-library evidence. It must be replaced or augmented with an accepted source and discovery binding before a terminal disposition is promoted.
source_reference_contract.source_and_route_are_independent: Retaining immutable source evidence does not retain a live route; retiring a live route does not authorize deleting, editing, or forking its upstream source.

promotion_requirements.source_identity: Every provisional source reference has an accepted immutable revision and content identity.
promotion_requirements.license_and_attribution: Every imported behavior has per-source revision, license, attribution requirement, and destination NOTICE or non-derivative evidence.
promotion_requirements.behavior_partition: Every retiring route has an accepted exhaustive partition of its material source behaviors into migrated, retained-external, or dropped-with-reason outcomes.
promotion_requirements.route_identity: Every live route is bound by source or provider, route id, discovery precedence, and supported client.
promotion_requirements.qualification: Every required replacement owner and capability is qualified before install-before-remove retirement begins.

source_artifacts.source_evidence_policy: Retain the manifest records, immutable comparison identities, revisions, and license evidence. Coordinated packages remain canonical candidate sources; managed and upstream records remain immutable evidence even when a live route is later retired.

Bind exact immutable upstream or personal-source identities, revisions, licenses, attribution requirements, and destination NOTICE or non-derivative evidence before using these references as import authority. Keep Review Atlas public-core provenance separate from the opaque private overlay. Preserve personal comparison identities even if their installed projections are later removed.
